overview: You sealed the letter and wrote Anne's direction on the outside, at Henley Street in Stratford, by Thomas Hobbins, the eleventh of September. The sheet stayed on the chest. You did not give it to anyone today.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Sealed the sheet and wrote the direction.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Named on the outside. Not present.

parties.name: Thomas Hobbins
parties.context: Named as the carrier. Not in the house.
